# PREMIUM SELLING MORNING BRIEF
**Market Open // August 4, 2026**

---

## 1. MARKET CONTEXT

SPY and QQQ flat at elevated levels with VIX sub-16 signals a low-vol, grind-higher regime that remains **favorable for premium selling**. HV ranks show elevated realized vol in mega-caps (TSLA 77, NVDA 78, AMD 74) vs subdued index vol (SPY 47, QQQ 60), creating attractive single-name opportunities. AAPL, AMZN, MSFT, and GOOGL all at 100 HV rank indicate abnormally high IV percentile—ideal for selling premium. Watch for earnings-driven vol compression this week (AMD today, LLY/SHOP/GILD tomorrow, OKLO Thursday).

---

- **Technical deterioration in TSLA:** Below both 50d ($388) and 200d ($411) MAs with 77 HV rank—elevated realized vol reflects genuine uncertainty; size conservatively and maintain strict stop discipline on short puts.
